lastCompletedStory.title: Accumulate session worker-token total from the event log and render it in the dashboard header

nextStoryContext: Both PRD stories (US-001 session elapsed, US-002 session token cost) now pass. This was the last story in prd.json (2 of 2, priority-ordered) -- no non-operator story remains with passes:false. The next agent invocation should find nothing to implement and should defer to the review cycle (/cam-review) rather than picking a story. US-002 added sumSessionWorkerTokens (src/commands/dashboard.ts): a pure helper summing the four TokensEventDetail fields (inputTokens+outputTokens+cacheReadTokens+cacheCreationTokens) across worker 'tokens' events in .claude/cam-worker-events.jsonl at-or-after the US-001 sidecar session-start marker (readSidecarSessionStart), returning undefined (not 0) both when the log is absent and when nothing falls in the session window -- the renderer omits the row in both cases. 'cycle-tokens' aggregate events (CAM-131) are excluded for free since only kind==='tokens' lines are summed. readSnapshot exposes this as the optional sessionWorkerTokens DashboardData field, gated behind the same sessionStartIso-present check used for sessionStartedAtMs. Dashboard.tsx's Loop SummaryPanel renders it as a new 'cost' row (formatTokens(n) + ' tokens', muted, never USD) placed between the existing 'tokens' row (current-run orchestrator usage) and 'branch'. If a future story extends the PRD, mirror this row-placement convention (state/story/progress/since/session/tokens/cost/branch) and the readSnapshot session-start gating pattern (see scripts/cam/patterns.md's 'Session-window token summation' bullet).

officialDocsValidated.summary: Story only reused already-established internal patterns (event-log JSONL parsing mirroring parseRecentProgress/extractTokensFromLine, and the existing Ink Section/SummaryRow/Text components already used for the session row); no new external API surface was introduced.
